description.value:
Craft Cost 4 Vitae Points

Activate 1 action to drink

Restores 8d8 HP, clears drained, enfeebled, sickened, and clumsy all at once, and grants resistance 5 to physical damage for 1 minute.

cinderfall.incomplete: The heal/cure clauses need no rules entry (Pattern INSTANT). The 1-minute resistance-5-physical clause is a duration buff with no companion effect file: This is an activated, duration-limited self-buff shaped exactly like this corpus's own 13 companion-effect pairs (apex-draught -> apex-draught-effect, etc.) and the real pf2e precedent for that shape (pf2e-source/packs/pf2e/equipment/juggernaut-mutagen-lesser.json + equipment-effects/effect-juggernaut-mutagen-lesser.json; feats/class/monk/level-1/gorilla-stance.json + feat-effects/stance-gorilla-stance.json) -- in both, the triggering card's rules: [] is correct and the numeric payload lives on a separate companion Effect item the triggering card GrantItems into. No matching *-effect.json companion exists for this card, so the mechanism is real but the sibling file it would need is missing -- a card-authoring gap, not an engine limitation.
